newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's YTL to hold news conference.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's YTL to hold news conference.

text.p: Malaysian infrastructure developer and power concern YTL Corp Bhd, in the news lately because of its expressed interested in a Hong Kong power company, will hold a news conference on Tuesday at 5 p.m. (0900 GMT), the company said on Monday.
It did not disclose the topic of the conference.

YTL has been in the news over the past week because it has expressed interest in possibly acquiring a controlling stake in Hong Kong's Consolidated Electric Power Asia Ltd (CEPA). It has not made a formal offer for CEPA.
Meanwhile, CEPA's parent Hopewell Holdings Ltd has agreed to sell most of its stake in the unit to U.S. utility Southern Co's Southern Electric International.

Also late last month, YTL announced a power privatisation deal with the Zimbabwean government. The project became controversial after Zimbabwe sacked the entire board of its power utility for opposing the deal.
